'''Anj Zavor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="anh" /> Zavor attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the Alliance<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|133|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Celebrating a Rebel Victory!}}</ref> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Alliance [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="New Essential Chronology" /> Following the battle, a [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]] was held in the [[Grand Audience Chamber]] of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], the Alliance's base on Yavin 4. Zavor was present at the ceremony, during which the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]] was awarded to [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], along with two other [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|heroes]] of the battle, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Anj Zavor had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a mustache, as well as fair skin.<ref name="anh" />

==Behind the scenes==
Portrayed by an uncredited [[Henry Roberts]],<ref name="ShowMaster">{{WebCite|url=https://www.showmasterssales.com/products/henry-roberts-10x8-signed-in-silver-image-a|text=Henry Roberts 10X8 Signed in Silver - Star Wars|work=[http://showmasterssales.com Showmasters Comic Con Official Autograph Shop]|archivedate=20210228175648}}</ref> Anj Zavor first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] in the ending ceremony honoring the Heroes of Yavin.<ref name="anh" /> Roberts' scene was shot at [[Shepperton Studios]] between [[May 13]] and [[May 18]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars]]''</ref> On [[May 1]], [[2012]],<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/133|text=Star Wars Insider #133}}</ref> the character was given a name in [[Leland Chee]]'s "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" feature of [[Star Wars Insider 133|''Star Wars Insider'' 133]].<ref name="Insider" />
